prompt: Min-max scale a feature column into the range 0..1, handling the constant column that would otherwise divide by zero. Complete the normalize and normalizeAll methods in the starter file.
explanation: Min-max scaling is (value - min) / (max - min), which puts the smallest value at 0.0 and the largest at 1.0 so features measured in wildly different units become comparable. The interesting part is the guard: when every value is identical the range is 0 and the formula would divide by zero, so the convention is to return all zeros. Allocating the result array up front means the empty and constant cases can simply return it untouched.
hints: Find min and max in one pass before you scale anything.
double[] scaled = new double[column.length] is already the correct answer for an empty or constant column.
normalizeAll should copy table[i][col] into a plain array and then call normalize -- do not duplicate the scaling logic.
